import json

import numpy as np
import ml_dtypes

def decode(v):
    if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get('__sparse__'):

        if isinstance(v, np.ndarray):

        if isinstance(v, list):
            return [convert(x) for x in v]
        return v

    def array(v):
        if isinstance(v, tf.SparseTensor):
            return tf.sparse.to_dense(v).numpy()
        if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor):
            if v.is_sparse:
                v = v.to_dense()
            if v.dtype == torch.bfloat16:
                return v.detach().float().numpy().astype(ml_dtypes.bfloat16)
            return v.detach().numpy()
        return np.asarray(v.numpy()) if isinstance(v, tf.Tensor) else np.asarray(v)

    path = folder / f'{role}-operation.py'

    fn = namespace['pytorch_call' if fw == 'torch' else 'tensorflow_call']
    kwargs = convert(decode(item['arguments']))
    if item['mode'] == 'sparse':
        x = decode(item['arguments'])['x'].copy()
        x[x < 0.5] = 0
        idx = np.stack(np.nonzero(x), axis=1)
        vals = x[tuple(idx.T)]
        kwargs = {'x': tf.SparseTensor(idx, vals, x.shape) if fw == 'tensorflow' else torch.sparse_coo_tensor(torch.tensor(idx.T), torch.tensor(vals), x.shape).coalesce()}
    actual = fn(**kwargs)
    expected = decode(item['source_reference'])
    setting = item['oracle_settings']
    value_test(ret_np_flat=[array(actual)], ret_np_from_gt_flat=[expected], rtol=setting['rtol'], atol=setting['atol'], specific_tolerance_dict=setting['tolerance_dict'], test_dtypes=setting['test_dtypes'], backend=fw, ground_truth_backend=meta['source_framework'])
    if meta['official_sign']:

    if item['mode'] == 'sparse':

        if fw == 'tensorflow':
            assert isinstance(actual, tf.SparseTensor)
            indices = actual.indices.numpy().tolist()
            shape = actual.dense_shape.numpy().tolist()
        else:
            assert actual.is_sparse
            actual = actual.coalesce()
            indices = actual.indices().T.tolist()
            shape = list(actual.shape)
        assert indices == ref['indices'] and shape == ref['shape']
    if 'source_gradient' in item:
        x = decode(item['arguments'])['x']
        if fw == 'tensorflow':
            v = tf.Variable(x)
            with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
                total = tf.reduce_sum(fn(x=v))
            gradient = tape.gradient(total, v)
        else:
            v = torch.tensor(x, requires_grad=True)
            gradient, = torch.autograd.grad(fn(x=v).sum(), v)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(array(gradient), decode(item['source_gradient']), rtol=0.001, atol=0.001)
